answer: Every claim climbs the wharf of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the voyage re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the cedar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
